raidIntervals.method: ordinary-confirm request to deferred LocalGame.Stop; for budget charge conservative native result screen 101 seconds instead

method: Elapsed live-raid intervals include tool delays while the raid continues; pre-raid and post-raid loading/menu/tool timestamps are recorded separately.

toolTiming.note: Input request/resolution and screenshot archive timestamps are in input-actions/originals-index. Captures, reads, analysis and waiting are interleaved. An exact independent total for all tool execution is unavailable. In-raid tool and waiting time is INCLUDED in the conservative 101-second charge; pre/post loading and menus are separate.
